# Version 4.150.4
> **Glyph and stencil corrections** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.4)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.4 fixes glyph-atlas reuse and shared stencil tracking.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct GPU text and stencil state** — Prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from treating evicted glyph locations as current, and tracks shared stencil-clear rectangles in backend-native coordinates. ([#5113](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5113), [#5083](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5083))
- **Windows HarfBuzz scanning compatibility** — Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged. ([#5123](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5123))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.4

Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.
